area51_followup.summary: A later caller stated that he was the frantic 1997 Area 51 caller and had been acting a character. This strongly downgrades the extraordinary content. The coincident satellite/network interruption remains a real broadcast event but is not evidence that the caller's story caused it.
area51_followup.topa_lesson: A dramatic coincidence survives in the raw ledger even when the narrative claim is downgraded; never let an unexplained technical event resurrect a falsified identity claim.
